name: 76248 · Keller, TX
findings: ZIP 76248 (Keller) has 143 nonprofit organizations. 57 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 45 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 76248 (Keller) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
